Russia’s security cooperation with Afghanistan in Central Asia has continued uninterrupted , special presidential envoy for Afghanistan Zamir Kabulov told TASS following Deputy Prime Minister Alexey Overchuk’s visit to Kabul. “We have never stopped working on this. They are fulfilling their part of the task, and we are very grateful to them. They are crushing the IS (also known as ISIS or the Islamic State terrorist organization, which is banned in Russia), which could otherwise spoil the mood for both us and Central Asia. The Afghans are doing this at their own expense,” he noted.
